title: Too firm for sleeping on side
text: Too firm for sleeping on side. It's a nice mattress. Will not be keeping mattress. Ordered mattress from purple to get the 100 day trial. Mattress feels soft at first when crawling on mattress or pressing in with hand. While laying on the mattress it is firm. It bothers me at the hips . I am a 140lb male and sleep on my side. Mattress does not get hot which I like. The mattress is pretty heavy. My wife likes the mattress for the height, the headboard shows more. She like it, though she can sleep on anything.
